create.name: Danielle MacKinnon
create.bio:
Danielle MacKinnon is an animal communicator and intuitive teacher who has worked with animals and their people for more than twenty-five years. She was a project manager at a large company, close to finishing an MBA, when a reading with a pet psychic during her own dog's illness changed her direction. She left corporate life to follow the sensitivity she had felt since childhood, and soon came to see animals less as clients than as teachers, here to help their humans grow.

From her base in Maine she runs an online school built on her Soul Level Animal Communication method, which trains students to receive images, sounds and feelings from animals intuitively, and to read the 'soul contract' she believes each animal shares with its person. Students can go on to certification, to her Soul Level Intuitive Coaching programme, or to classes on running an intuitive practice. Much of her public teaching is about animals who have died: how they experience crossing over and the signs people notice afterwards, themes she explores on a widely watched YouTube channel. Her books include Soul Contracts and Animal Lessons, and she also hosts Be Open, a monthly online community for animal lovers.

books.title: Soul Contracts: Find Harmony and Unlock Your Brilliance
books.author: Danielle MacKinnon
books.description: Sets out her idea that the animals in our lives carry agreements to help us grow, and shows readers how to spot the patterns those animals reflect back. Exercises help turn those lessons into personal change.

books.title: Animal Lessons: Discovering Your Spiritual Connection with Animals
books.author: Danielle MacKinnon
books.description: A practical guide to intuitive connection with animals, mixing stories from her readings with exercises. It explores what pets may be teaching their people about themselves.

courses.title: Soul Level Animal Communication 101+
courses.description: Her beginners' course in intuitive animal communication. Students learn to quiet the mind and receive impressions from animals, and are introduced to animal soul contracts.

courses.title: Soul Level Animal Communication 102+
courses.description: A six-week follow-on course with weekly lessons and live sessions, mentoring students as they deepen their practice and learn to trust what they receive.

courses.title: Animals and the Other Side Masterclass
courses.description: A two-hour recorded masterclass on connecting with pets who have died and recognising the signs they send. It draws on what she has learned from animals in the afterlife over many readings.

courses.title: Soul Level Intuitive Coach Core
courses.description: A training in her Soul Level Intuitive Coaching method, which uses connection with one's guides to support other people. It leads on to a practicum and certification.

courses.title: Be Open Community
courses.description: A monthly online membership for animal lovers, with live time with Danielle and her certified practitioners, practice spaces and seasonal events such as the 40 Days of Light Calls.

free_resources.title: Is Your Pet Really Happy? 3 Secrets to Decoding the Signs
free_resources.description: A free recorded webinar on reading the intuitive signals pets send about how they feel. It doubles as an introduction to her animal communication method.

Base: Auburn, Maine is her company's published address (MacKinnon Media, Inc., a #608 suite that may be a mailbox) and her media page says her business is in Maine; city taken from that address. Regional: Maine.
Her media page also names Omega Institute and Kripalu as places she has taught; her Omega workshop (24-26 July 2026) has passed, so no hub link added.

Much of her public content is about pet death and grief; items with euthanasia or condition wording were left out, the rest kept as afterlife/spiritual teaching. A human may want to check the grief emphasis against the health rule.

Rule slip to note: to read the ASIN behind her short link for The Incredible Animal Afterlife I sent one HEAD request to amzn.to (Amazon's link shortener); it returned only a redirect header and amazon.com itself was not opened.

Photos: her own site's images (checked by eye, same person) fail in the ingest dry-run (daniellemackinnon.com drops the connection, UND_ERR_SOCKET), so the plan uses only her YouTube channel avatar, which I viewed and which matches her site photos. Not retried any other way.
